title: Multi-modal Agent Tuning: Building a VLM-Driven Agent for Efficient Tool Usage
authors_zh: Zhi Gao、Bofei Zhang、Pengxiang Li、Xiaojian Ma、Tao Yuan、Yue Fan、Yuwei Wu、Yunde Jia、Song-Chun Zhu、Qing Li
paper_type_zh: 多模态 agent 轨迹构造 recipe、数据发布与模型研究
best_for_zh: 研究多模态工具使用 SFT、合成 ReAct 轨迹、LLM-as-judge 筛选或开放数据审计的读者
one_line: Multi-modal Agent Tuning synthesizes queries and files, executes GPT-4o-mini-controlled ReAct trajectories, applies query-file and trajectory judges, and fine-tunes VLM controllers on thought-and-code supervision.
Multi-modal Agent Tuning 用 GPT-4o mini 生成查询、文件与 ReAct 轨迹并经可执行代码门槛和双重同源 judge 筛选，公开 21,168 条 MM-Traj 记录；其构造 recipe 可供研究，但许可冲突、schema 失败、缺少拒绝账本与独立正确性核验阻断直接训练复用。
why: It documents an unusually inspectable multimodal agent-data pipeline while showing why executable traces and two judges are insufficient without independent correctness checks, source-rights inheritance, stable row/file lineage, rejected examples, and reproducible release manifests.
inclusion_reason: MM-Traj is a concrete construction-recipe case: it combines seed prompting, multimodal file retrieval/generation, executable ReAct rollouts, and dual LLM filtering into tool-use SFT data. Its public release exposes correlated verification, heterogeneous source rights, schema drift, count reconciliation, rejected-data, lineage, privacy, and execution-safety risks.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The canonical paper is the 32-page proceedings version of Multi-modal Agent Tuning: Building a VLM-Driven Agent for Efficient Tool Usage, published at ICLR 2025 and listed in the official Spotlight program. The Card also checks arXiv:2412.15606 v2, the author project, code, dataset, and model releases. This verifies the citation and the existence of public artifacts; it does not certify the dataset license, source rights, or reproducibility.

The engineering problem is how to construct enough multimodal, multi-tool trajectories to train a VLM controller. Prior prompt-driven agents rely on fixed demonstrations, while existing VLM-agent data described by the paper concentrates on simple tasks with one or two tools. The paper therefore generates queries matched to files, lets an agent interact with tools, filters the resulting trajectories, and uses the retained thought-and-code sequence for supervised controller tuning (Paper Sections 1 and 3).

One paper-level MM-Traj item is {F_opt, Q, T, C, O, A}: optional files, a query, stepwise thoughts, executable Python calls, observations, and a final answer. The pinned HF row is a narrower serialization with id, heterogeneous image, string answer, and conversations. This distinction matters because verifier decisions, rejection reasons, source IDs, file hashes, and most construction provenance are absent from the released row.

The work belongs in Data Construction and Open Release Recipes because its main reusable contribution is the path from seed prompts and a 93K image-caption pool through file generation, ReAct rollout, an executable-code gate, two LLM judges, and SFT export. It is not a programmatically verified outcome release: execution only shows that code ran, while semantic correctness still depends on GPT-4o-mini judgments. It also does not provide preference pairs, process labels, a trained reward model, or RLVR data.

The Card reaches L4 because the paper, appendix prompts, official repositories, pinned release contents, counts, licenses, and concrete failure surfaces have been examined bilingually. Its reuse boundary remains conservative: MM-Traj is useful as a construction and audit case, but direct training reuse is blocked by conflicting license declarations, unreconciled source rights and counts, a broken viewer schema, missing rejected examples and judge outputs, and undisclosed sandbox and contamination controls.

规范论文来源是 Multi-modal Agent Tuning: Building a VLM-Driven Agent for Efficient Tool Usage 的 32 页 proceedings 版本；论文发表于 ICLR 2025，并列入官方 Spotlight 日程。本卡还核查了 arXiv:2412.15606 v2、作者项目页、代码、数据集与模型发布。这些证据确认了引用和公开 artifact 的存在，但不等于数据许可、上游权利或可复现性已经得到认证。

该工作的工程问题是如何构造足够多的多模态、多工具轨迹来训练 VLM controller。以 prompt 驱动的 agent 依赖固定 demonstration，而论文所述既有 VLM-agent 数据多集中于只需一两个工具的简单任务。因此，论文生成与文件匹配的 query，让 agent 与工具交互，筛选所得轨迹，再以保留的 thought-and-code 序列监督微调 controller（论文第 1、3 节）。

论文层面的一条 MM-Traj 数据是 {F_opt, Q, T, C, O, A}：可选文件、查询、逐步 thought、可执行 Python 调用、observation 和最终答案。固定版本的 HF 行采用更窄的序列化，只含 id、异构 image、字符串 answer 与 conversations。这一区别很重要，因为 verifier 决策、拒绝原因、来源 ID、文件 hash 和大部分构造 provenance 都没有进入发布行。

本工作属于 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes，因为其主要可复用贡献是从 seed prompt 与 93K 图像-caption 池出发，经文件生成、ReAct rollout、可执行代码门槛、两级 LLM judge，最后导出 SFT 数据的完整路径。它不是 programmatically verified outcome release：执行只说明代码能够运行，语义正确性仍由 GPT-4o-mini 判断；它也没有提供 preference pair、process label、训练得到的 reward model 或 RLVR 数据。

本卡达到 L4，是因为论文、附录 prompt、官方仓库、固定版本发布内容、计数、许可和具体失败面都已完成双语核查。复用边界仍然保守：MM-Traj 可作为构造与审计案例，但许可声明冲突、上游权利和计数未对齐、viewer schema 失败、缺少拒绝样本和 judge output，以及 sandbox 与污染控制未披露，都会阻断直接训练复用。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a closed construction loop for multimodal tool-use SFT: GPT-4o mini creates tasks and non-image files, a GPT-4o-mini ReAct controller produces thought/code/observation trajectories, and the same model family supplies two filtering judgments before VLM trajectory tuning.

The data surface is an episode rather than a prompt-answer pair. Its behavior is the sequence of thought T, code action C, and resulting observation O, conditioned on optional files F and query Q; the final answer A closes the episode but is excluded from the training loss. Supervision therefore attaches to state-action behavior and full-episode acceptance. The release does not expose a standalone step label, scalar reward, preference pair, or verifier target.

The feedback contract is mixed. Python execution is environmental evidence: a tool call must run and yield an observation. The query-file judge asks whether the supplied files are relevant, sufficient, and solvable with the available tools. The trajectory judge asks whether tool choices, arguments, reasoning, observations, and the final answer are mutually consistent. Neither judge has an independent answer oracle, and both use GPT-4o mini, the same model used for generation. They can observe the serialized task and execution results, but cannot establish source rights, detect all hallucinated semantics, or reveal errors shared with the teacher.

The nearest baseline direction in the paper is prompt-engineered LLM/VLM tool agents, including the GPT-4-driven agent contrasted with T3-Agent in Figure 1, plus VLM-agent datasets built from manually defined templates and short one- or two-tool tasks. GTA and GAIA are evaluation surfaces, not substitutes for MM-Traj records. The concrete change is to synthesize matched multimodal files and longer executable trajectories at scale and then train an open VLM controller, rather than keeping a proprietary LLM controller behind in-context examples.

The directional lesson is not “two judges make data correct.” It is that multimodal agent data can be organized around executable actions and observation-conditioned continuation. The audit lesson is equally central: using one proprietary model as query generator, file generator, rollout policy, and both judges couples their failure modes and turns hidden judge preferences into an undocumented selection objective.

该工作的贡献是一个面向多模态工具使用 SFT 的闭环构造流程：GPT-4o mini 创建任务与非图像文件，由 GPT-4o-mini ReAct controller 生成 thought/code/observation 轨迹，再由同一模型家族提供两级筛选判断，之后进行 VLM trajectory tuning。

数据表面是 episode，而不是 prompt-answer pair。其行为是在可选文件 F 与查询 Q 条件下，由 thought T、代码 action C 和对应 observation O 组成的序列；最终答案 A 结束 episode，但不进入训练 loss。因此，监督附着于 state-action 行为和完整 episode 的接收决策。发布中没有独立 step label、scalar reward、preference pair 或 verifier target。

Feedback contract 是 mixed。Python 执行提供环境证据：工具调用必须运行并产生 observation。query-file judge 判断文件是否相关、信息是否充分、任务能否用现有工具求解；trajectory judge 判断工具选择、参数、推理、observation 和最终答案是否一致。两者都没有独立答案 oracle，而且都使用与生成阶段相同的 GPT-4o mini。它们能观察序列化任务与执行结果，却不能确认来源权利、识别所有语义幻觉，也无法暴露与 teacher 共享的错误。

论文中最接近的 baseline 方向是 prompt-engineered LLM/VLM 工具 agent，包括图 1 中与 T3-Agent 对比的 GPT-4-driven agent，以及依赖人工模板、只覆盖一两个工具短任务的 VLM-agent 数据。GTA 与 GAIA 是 evaluation surface，不是 MM-Traj 记录的替代品。真正变化是规模化合成匹配的多模态文件和更长的可执行轨迹，再训练开放 VLM controller，而不是让 proprietary LLM controller 继续依赖 in-context example。

方向性结论不是“两个 judge 就能保证数据正确”，而是多模态 agent 数据可以围绕可执行 action 与 observation-conditioned continuation 来组织。同样重要的审计结论是：query、文件、rollout policy 和两个 judge 都依赖同一个 proprietary model，会耦合失败模式，并把隐藏的 judge 偏好变成未记录的 selection objective。

title: Method
方法
html:
The pipeline can be reconstructed at the level disclosed by the paper:

  1. Inputs. Authors manually brainstorm and double-check seed queries. Tool descriptions and randomly sampled seed demonstrations condition GPT-4o mini. For images, the pipeline builds a 93K image-caption pool from ChartQA, COCO, LLaVA, SAM, TextVQA, Web-Celebrity, Web-Landmark, and WikiArt, using ShareGPT4V captions.
  2. Query and file construction. GPT-4o mini writes a new query and identifies required files. BGE retrieves top-similar images; GPT-4o mini generates content and Python materialization code for non-image objects such as PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, CSV, and audio.
  3. Interaction. A zero-shot ReAct agent controlled by GPT-4o mini receives the query, files, and tool descriptions. At each step it writes a thought, emits executable Python code, and conditions the next step on the returned observation. Most reported trajectories contain two to six steps; some contain seven or eight.
  4. Environmental gate and judgments. Only trajectories whose code executes are collected. A GPT-4o-mini query-file judge checks relevance, sufficiency, and solvability; a second GPT-4o-mini judge checks the trajectory and final answer. Retention requires both approvals.
  5. Output and training. The paper reports 23.5K generated candidates filtered to about 20K tasks with about 15K files. MM-Traj is mixed with Cauldron and open-LLaVA-NeXT, then used for five-epoch SFT of MiniCPM-V-8.5B or Qwen2-VL-7B controllers. The vision encoder/compressor are frozen; rank-64 LoRA is applied to LM q/k/v; context length is 10,240, learning rate 1e-6, and batch size 2. Loss covers thought and code tokens, not final answer A.

Construction temperature is not reproducible from the paper: it says query temperature is tuned but gives no value. Checked scripts set temperature 1 and name gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, yet no immutable manifest binds those files to the paper run. Maximum rollout steps, token and tool-cost budget, timeouts, retries, concurrency, API versions, and random seed are unknown.

The pinned dataset differs from the rounded paper funnel: mat_train.json has 21,168 unique rows, while data.zip has 19,307 regular files. Reproduction must therefore pin the code, dataset, and model revisions; repair the final verifier's nonexistent prompt paths; reconstruct external caption/embedding assets; and create mappings among source files, generated attachments, JSON rows, verifier decisions, training membership, and checkpoints. There is no released split or contamination procedure to reproduce.

在论文披露范围内，pipeline 可以重建为：

  1. 输入。 作者人工 brainstorm 并 double-check seed query。工具描述和随机抽取的 seed demonstration 作为 GPT-4o mini 的条件。针对图像，流程使用 ShareGPT4V caption，从 ChartQA、COCO、LLaVA、SAM、TextVQA、Web-Celebrity、Web-Landmark 与 WikiArt 构建 93K 图像-caption 池。
  2. Query 与文件构造。 GPT-4o mini 编写新 query 并判断所需文件。BGE 检索最相似图像；对于 PDF、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX、CSV、音频等非图像对象，GPT-4o mini 生成内容和 Python 物化代码。
  3. 交互。 由 GPT-4o mini 控制的 zero-shot ReAct agent 接收 query、文件与工具描述。每一步先写 thought，再输出可执行 Python 代码，并以返回的 observation 为条件继续。论文中的多数轨迹有二至六步，少数达到七至八步。
  4. 环境门槛与 judge。 只有代码能够执行的轨迹才会被收集。GPT-4o-mini query-file judge 检查相关性、信息充分性和可解性，第二个 GPT-4o-mini judge 检查轨迹和最终答案；两个判断都通过才保留。
  5. 输出与训练。 论文报告 23.5K 个生成 candidate 经筛选后得到约 20K 个任务和约 15K 个文件。MM-Traj 与 Cauldron、open-LLaVA-NeXT 混合，用于对 MiniCPM-V-8.5B 或 Qwen2-VL-7B controller 进行五轮 SFT。vision encoder/compressor 冻结，LM q/k/v 使用 rank-64 LoRA；context length 为 10,240，learning rate 为 1e-6，batch size 为 2。Loss 只覆盖 thought 与 code token，不覆盖最终答案 A。

构造 temperature 无法由论文复现：正文只说 query temperature 经过调节，却没有给出数值。已检查脚本使用 temperature 1，并指定 gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18，但没有不可变 manifest 把这些文件绑定到论文运行。最大 rollout step、token 与工具成本预算、timeout、retry、concurrency、API version 和随机 seed 均为 unknown。

固定版本数据集与论文的四舍五入漏斗并不一致：mat_train.json 有 21,168 条 unique row，而 data.zip 有 19,307 个普通文件。因此，复现必须固定代码、数据集和模型 revision，修复最终 verifier 中不存在的 prompt path，重建外部 caption/embedding asset，并建立 source file、生成 attachment、JSON row、verifier decision、训练 membership 与 checkpoint 之间的映射。没有可复现的 split 或污染处理流程被发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
All performance claims below are author-reported and were not independently reproduced. The most direct selection ablation compares training data without versus with both verifiers: GTA accuracy rises from 50.00 to 52.56 and GAIA from 13.33 to 15.15 (Paper Section 4.3, Table 5). This is evidence that the filtering configuration affected downstream scores; it is not a measurement of judge precision, record correctness, or source quality.

The scaling ablation holds the reported training recipe while varying MM-Traj size: 6K, 12K, and 20K records yield GTA accuracies of 43.59, 48.08, and 52.56, with reported training times of 276, 532, and 946 minutes and 214 GB memory (Appendix B.1, Table 8). This supports a data-quantity trend under one setup, but subset IDs, sampling seeds, uniqueness, and independent reruns are absent.

For the human study, 30 programmers each rate 20 examples blindly mixed from retained and filtered groups. Tables report retained versus filtered task scores of 8.32 versus 6.36 and trajectory scores of 8.67 versus 6.38 (Paper Section 4.3; Appendix A.1, Table 6). However, adjacent appendix prose instead gives 7.96/6.30 and 8.64/6.24. Without the 600 ratings, assignments, agreement statistics, or corrected report, the study cannot calibrate either judge's false accepts and false rejects.

The release audit supplies a different kind of evidence. At the pinned HF revision, the JSON has exactly 21,168 records and unique IDs. image is a dictionary in 14,558 rows and a string in 6,610; this heterogeneity breaks the declared viewer schema. The remote ZIP contains 19,307 regular files, whereas the paper summarizes about 20K tasks and 15K files after a 23.5K-candidate funnel. These figures refer to different units and cannot be reconciled without a manifest.

Benchmark gains therefore do not prove that MM-Traj is correctly licensed, independently verified, decontaminated, complete, or safe to execute. The strongest supported conclusion is narrower: the paper demonstrates that executable, judged multimodal trajectories can train VLM tool controllers, and its ablations associate both filtering and more retained records with higher reported GTA/GAIA scores under the stated setup.

以下性能主张均由作者报告，尚未独立复现。最直接的 selection ablation 对比了不使用与同时使用两个 verifier 的训练数据：GTA accuracy 从 50.00 升至 52.56，GAIA 从 13.33 升至 15.15（论文第 4.3 节，表 5）。这说明筛选配置影响了下游分数，但没有测量 judge precision、逐条正确性或来源质量。

Scaling ablation 在论文所述训练 recipe 下改变 MM-Traj 规模：6K、12K、20K 条记录分别得到 43.59、48.08、52.56 的 GTA accuracy，报告训练时间为 276、532、946 分钟，memory 为 214 GB（附录 B.1，表 8）。这支持单一设置下的数据量趋势，但 subset ID、sampling seed、唯一性与独立 rerun 均缺失。

在人类研究中，30 名程序员各评 20 个从保留组与过滤组盲混的 example。表格给出的保留/过滤 task score 为 8.32/6.36，trajectory score 为 8.67/6.38（论文第 4.3 节；附录 A.1，表 6）。然而，相邻附录正文又写成 7.96/6.30 和 8.64/6.24。缺少 600 份 rating、分配、agreement statistic 与更正报告时，该研究无法校准任一 judge 的 false accept 与 false reject。

发布审计提供了另一类证据。在固定 HF revision 上，JSON 恰有 21,168 条记录且 ID 唯一；14,558 行的 image 是 dictionary，6,610 行是 string，这种异构性使声明的 viewer schema 失败。远程 ZIP 有 19,307 个普通文件，而论文把 23.5K candidate 经过筛选后的结果概括为约 20K 个任务、15K 个文件。这些数字使用不同单位，没有 manifest 就无法对齐。

因此，benchmark gain 不能证明 MM-Traj 已正确授权、经过独立核验、完成去污染、发布完整或能够安全执行。证据支持的更窄结论是：论文展示了可执行且经 judge 筛选的多模态轨迹能够训练 VLM 工具 controller；在所述设置下，其 ablation 把筛选与更多保留记录同更高的 GTA/GAIA 报告分数联系起来。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is not “no multimodal agents.” The paper situates itself among LLM-driven agents that call tools through pseudocode, Python, or JSON and VLM-driven agents that can condition on visual inputs. Its narrower premise is that existing VLM-agent tuning data tends to use manual templates, small collections, or simple one- and two-tool tasks, while prompt-only proprietary controllers depend on fixed in-context examples (Paper Sections 1 and 2.1).

The concrete change is the composition of four elements into one data recipe: generate a query together with required files; retrieve images or generate heterogeneous non-image files; collect observation-conditioned executable ReAct trajectories; then apply separate query-file and trajectory judgments before SFT. This makes {F_opt,Q,T,C,O,A} a multimodal agent-training object rather than flattening the task to question and answer.

Several components are inherited rather than new: ReAct supplies the thought/action/observation scaffold; GPT-4o mini supplies generation and judgment; BGE supplies similarity retrieval; existing image datasets and ShareGPT4V captions supply source material; LoRA, Cauldron, and open-LLaVA-NeXT are part of the training mixture. Scaling the funnel to 23.5K candidates and packaging a 21,168-row release are engineering and release contributions, not evidence of a new correctness principle.

The directional value for reasoning-data research is the explicit coupling of file construction, executable behavior, environment observation, filtering, and training loss. It provides a useful reference for what a multimodal agent record could preserve. Its equally important negative signal is that the public schema drops judge outputs, rejected episodes, source rights, and most lineage, so the release cannot support independent reconstruction of the selection contract.

Before reuse, a builder should verify an authoritative dataset license, reconcile upstream terms, repair and version the schema, map every attachment to a row and source, release both judge outputs and rejections, use independent answer checks where possible, pin the execution sandbox, and audit contamination. Without these checks, the novelty is best treated as a recipe and audit surface rather than an asset cleared for direct training.

Prior-work baseline 并不是“此前没有多模态 agent”。论文把自身放在两类工作之间：一类是通过 pseudocode、Python 或 JSON 调用工具的 LLM-driven agent，另一类是能够以视觉输入为条件的 VLM-driven agent。其更窄的出发点是，既有 VLM-agent tuning data 多依赖人工模板、小规模集合或一两个工具的简单任务，而只用 prompt 的 proprietary controller 又依赖固定 in-context example（论文第 1、2.1 节）。

具体变化是把四个要素合成一套数据 recipe：同时生成 query 与所需文件；检索图像或生成异构非图像文件；收集以 observation 为条件的可执行 ReAct 轨迹；在 SFT 前分别进行 query-file 与 trajectory 判断。这使 {F_opt,Q,T,C,O,A} 成为多模态 agent 训练对象，而不是把任务压平为问题和答案。

多项组件来自既有工作而非本文新创：ReAct 提供 thought/action/observation scaffold；GPT-4o mini 负责生成与判断；BGE 负责相似度检索；既有图像数据集和 ShareGPT4V caption 提供素材；LoRA、Cauldron 与 open-LLaVA-NeXT 进入训练 mixture。把漏斗扩到 23.5K candidate 并打包 21,168 行发布，是工程与 release 贡献，不是新的正确性原理。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，其方向价值是明确耦合文件构造、可执行行为、环境 observation、筛选和训练 loss，为多模态 agent record 应保存什么提供了具体参考。同样重要的负面信号是，公开 schema 丢失 judge output、拒绝 episode、来源权利和大部分 lineage，因此无法独立重建 selection contract。

复用前，builder 应确认权威 dataset license，对齐上游条款，修复并版本化 schema，把每个 attachment 映射到 row 与 source，发布两个 judge 的 output 和 rejection，在可能时增加独立答案检查，固定 execution sandbox，并审计污染。缺少这些检查时，该 novelty 最适合作为 recipe 与 audit surface，而不是已经获准直接训练的 asset。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Correlated feedback. GPT-4o mini generates queries, non-image files, and trajectories and also performs both judgments. Curator inference: shared errors and stylistic preferences can pass through both filters, while valid trajectories unlike the teacher's style may be rejected. No independent oracle, model panel, precision/recall study, or per-row decision is released.
  • Execution is a weak terminal predicate. The code gate detects runtime success, not whether the selected tool, observation, arithmetic, or final answer is correct. The trajectory judge remains semantic and model-based, creating false-accept, false-reject, verifier-gaming, and hidden-teacher-trait risks.
  • Verifier modality mismatch. The appendix query-file prompt is written in terms of images even though MM-Traj includes PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, CSV, audio, and other files. This can systematically mis-handle non-image sufficiency and relevance.
  • Human evidence is internally inconsistent. Appendix prose reports retained/filtered task and trajectory scores of 7.96/6.30 and 8.64/6.24, while Table 6 and the main discussion report 8.32/6.36 and 8.67/6.38. Raw ratings, agreement, judge confusion matrices, and corrected values are unavailable.
  • Release units do not reconcile. The paper reports 23.5K candidates, about 20K retained tasks, and about 15K files; the pinned release has 21,168 JSON rows and 19,307 ZIP files. Attachment references and physical files are additional units. No row-file manifest explains duplicates, missing references, or the paper/release drift.
  • Schema and pipeline failures are visible. image is a dictionary in 14,558 rows and a string in 6,610, breaking the HF viewer's declared schema. The checked final-verifier script points to prompt paths absent at its commit, so the advertised shell pipeline cannot run unchanged.
  • Rejected evidence is missing. Filtered trajectories used in the human study are not released, and there is no accepted/rejected ledger, executable status, verifier response, reason, retry, or failure manifest. Selection bias and informative failures cannot be audited.
  • Licenses do not form one grant. HF front matter says MIT while the card body says CC-BY-NC-4.0; code is MIT and the model is labeled CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. SA-1B has a limited research license, and COCO disclaims ownership of image copyrights. None of these declarations resolves row-level upstream rights.
  • Privacy and safety are unknown. Face, celebrity, landmark, web, and art sources lack record-level consent, attribution, PII review, redaction, takedown, and deletion records. Generated Python, web access, office/PDF inspection, image editing, face detection, and broad packages are released without a documented sandbox, egress policy, malicious-file screening, or incident ledger.
  • Contamination and replay are unresolved. No exact or semantic overlap audit covers GTA, GAIA, Cauldron, open-LLaVA-NeXT, upstream images/captions, or base-model pretraining. Random sampling has no fixed seed; external APIs, search, retrievers, models, and packages introduce version drift.
  • Modeling scope is narrower than the label. The authors state that intermediate multimodal results in trajectories are not handled. Reported benchmark gains therefore do not establish general multimodal-agent competence or certify the data's correctness, rights, provenance, or safety.

• 反馈高度同源。 GPT-4o mini 同时生成 query、非图像文件与轨迹，并负责两级判断。Curator inference：共享错误和风格偏好可能穿过两个 filter，而风格不同但有效的轨迹可能被拒绝。没有发布独立 oracle、model panel、precision/recall 研究或逐条决策。
  • 执行是较弱的 terminal predicate。 代码门槛只能发现 runtime success，不能判断工具选择、observation、算术或最终答案是否正确。trajectory judge 仍是模型语义判断，因此存在 false accept、false reject、verifier gaming 和 hidden teacher trait 风险。
  • Verifier 存在模态错配。 附录的 query-file prompt 只按图像表述，但 MM-Traj 还包含 PDF、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX、CSV、音频及其他文件。这可能系统性误判非图像文件的充分性和相关性。
  • 人类证据内部矛盾。 附录正文给出的保留/过滤 task 与 trajectory score 是 7.96/6.30 和 8.64/6.24，而表 6 与主文讨论则是 8.32/6.36 和 8.67/6.38。原始 rating、agreement、judge confusion matrix 与更正值均不可得。
  • 发布单位无法对齐。 论文报告 23.5K candidate、约 20K 个保留任务和约 15K 个文件；固定版本发布有 21,168 条 JSON row 和 19,307 个 ZIP 文件。Attachment reference 与物理文件还是额外单位。没有 row-file manifest 解释重复、缺失引用或论文/发布漂移。
  • Schema 与 pipeline 失败可直接观察。 14,558 行的 image 是 dictionary，6,610 行是 string，使 HF viewer 的声明 schema 失败。已检查 final-verifier script 指向该 commit 中不存在的 prompt path，所以公开 shell pipeline 无法原样跑通。
  • 拒绝证据缺失。 人类研究用到的 filtered trajectory 没有发布，也没有 accepted/rejected ledger、executable status、verifier response、reason、retry 或 failure manifest。选择偏差和信息丰富的失败均无法审计。
  • 多份许可不能合成一个授权。 HF front matter 写 MIT，card 正文写 CC-BY-NC-4.0；代码是 MIT，模型标为 CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0。SA-1B 使用受限研究许可，COCO 声明不拥有图像版权。这些声明都没有解决逐条上游权利。
  • Privacy 与安全均为 unknown。 人脸、名人、地标、网页与艺术来源缺少逐条 consent、attribution、PII review、redaction、takedown 和 deletion 记录。生成 Python、web access、Office/PDF 检查、图像编辑、人脸检测和广泛 package 均没有配套公开 sandbox、egress policy、恶意文件筛查或 incident ledger。
  • 污染与重放尚未解决。 没有 exact 或 semantic overlap audit 覆盖 GTA、GAIA、Cauldron、open-LLaVA-NeXT、上游图像/caption 或 base-model pretraining。随机采样无固定 seed，外部 API、搜索、retriever、模型与 package 都会引入 version drift。
  • 建模范围比标签更窄。 作者明确说没有处理轨迹中的 intermediate multimodal result。因此，benchmark gain 不能证明通用 multimodal-agent 能力，也不能认证数据正确性、权利、provenance 或安全。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, this work is useful as a construction pattern, release-audit case, and source of controlled ablations. Its current reuse class is blocked pending verification for direct training; the public records should not be treated as rights-cleared or independently verified examples.

  • Rebuild the episode schema. Preserve {F_opt,Q,T,C,O,A} plus source IDs and licenses, file hashes, tool/environment revisions, executable status, both judge prompts and responses, rejection reasons, and train/checkpoint membership. Do not collapse the object to the released conversation alone.
  • Separate feedback channels. Log runtime success, deterministic validators where available, query-file sufficiency, trajectory-quality judgment, and final-answer correctness as distinct fields. Compare the same-model dual judge with independent models, human audit, and domain-specific checkers.
  • Audit the funnel. Publish counts for seeds, generated candidates, executable candidates, each rejection stage, retained unique tasks, JSON rows, referenced attachments, and physical archive files. A signed manifest should reconcile 23.5K, about 20K, 21,168, about 15K, and 19,307.
  • Use failures as data. Release filtered trajectories and both false-accept and false-reject candidates. They can support judge calibration, rejection-policy comparisons, modality slices, and analysis of whether same-model filters select easier or stylistically familiar tasks.
  • Test modality robustness. Rewrite the image-only verifier prompt into typed contracts for image, document, spreadsheet, presentation, audio, video, and mixed-file tasks. Report verifier behavior and schema validity separately by modality and attachment cardinality.
  • Make execution reproducible and safer. Pin a container digest, package/tool/model versions, filesystem and network policy, credentials handling, timeouts, resources, state reset, malicious-file scanning, and stdout/stderr/exit records. Treat generated code and documents as untrusted inputs.
  • Run rights and contamination gates before reuse. Resolve the dataset license, retain upstream item IDs and terms, provide attribution and takedown paths, and audit exact and semantic overlap with GTA, GAIA, training mixtures, upstream captions/images, and base-model pretraining.

The released checkpoint may be studied under its separately stated model license, and the code under MIT, but those grants do not settle dataset or upstream-asset rights. MM-Traj is not suitable as an evaluation set because its overlap with GTA/GAIA and other mixtures is not audited. It also does not directly support preference learning, PRM training, reward modeling, or RLVR replay because rejected pairs, process labels, scalar rewards, and an independently executable correctness verifier are absent.

对于 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track，本工作适合作为构造 pattern、发布审计案例和受控 ablation 来源。当前复用等级是直接训练复用需等待核验；不能把公开记录视为已经完成权利清理或独立正确性核验的样本。

  • 重建 episode schema。 在 {F_opt,Q,T,C,O,A} 之外，保留 source ID 与 license、file hash、tool/environment revision、executable status、两个 judge 的 prompt 与 response、拒绝原因和 train/checkpoint membership。不要把对象压缩成只有公开 conversation。
  • 拆分反馈通道。 把 runtime success、可用时的 deterministic validator、query-file sufficiency、trajectory-quality judgment 和 final-answer correctness 记录成独立字段。将同模型 dual judge 与独立模型、人类审计和领域 checker 做对照。
  • 审计漏斗。 分别发布 seed、生成 candidate、可执行 candidate、每级 rejection、保留 unique task、JSON row、引用 attachment 和物理 archive file 的数量。签名 manifest 应对齐 23.5K、约 20K、21,168、约 15K 和 19,307。
  • 把失败保留为数据。 发布 filtered trajectory，以及可能的 false accept 与 false reject。它们可用于 judge calibration、rejection-policy 比较、模态切片，以及分析同模型 filter 是否偏好更容易或风格更熟悉的任务。
  • 测试模态稳健性。 把只面向图像的 verifier prompt 改写为 image、document、spreadsheet、presentation、audio、video 与 mixed-file 任务的 typed contract。按模态和 attachment 数量分别报告 verifier 行为与 schema 有效性。
  • 让执行可复现且更安全。 固定 container digest、package/tool/model version、filesystem 与 network policy、credential handling、timeout、resource、state reset、恶意文件扫描，以及 stdout/stderr/exit 记录。把生成代码与文档都视作不可信输入。
  • 复用前执行权利与污染门槛。 解决 dataset license，保留上游 item ID 与条款，提供 attribution 与 takedown 路径，并审计与 GTA、GAIA、训练 mixture、上游 caption/image 和 base-model pretraining 的 exact 与 semantic overlap。

公开 checkpoint 可在其单独声明的 model license 下研究，代码可按 MIT 研究，但这些授权没有解决数据集或上游 asset 权利。MM-Traj 不适合作为 evaluation set，因为其与 GTA/GAIA 及其他 mixture 的重叠未经审计。它也不能直接支持 preference learning、PRM training、reward modeling 或 RLVR replay，因为缺少 rejected pair、process label、scalar reward 和可独立执行的 correctness verifier。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Paper Sections 3.1–3.6 first: the key object is {F_opt,Q,T,C,O,A}, and the construction path is query/file synthesis -> GPT-4o-mini ReAct rollout -> executable-code gate -> query-file judge -> trajectory judge.
  • Keep the scale units separate: the paper's 23.5K candidates, about 20K tasks, and about 15K files do not equal the pinned 21,168 JSON rows or 19,307 ZIP files; no manifest reconciles them.
  • Treat Table 5 as a filtering ablation, not verifier certification: GTA moves 50.00 -> 52.56 and GAIA 13.33 -> 15.15, but no judge precision, recall, agreement, or independent correctness audit is reported.
  • Read Appendix A.1/Table 6 together: the prose and table give contradictory human scores. Also inspect the image-only verifier prompt and the repository's broken final prompt paths before claiming reproducibility.
  • The reuse blockers are the MIT versus CC-BY-NC-4.0 dataset conflict, separate CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 model label, SA-1B/COCO upstream terms, broken HF schema, missing rejected ledger and lineage, and undisclosed privacy, sandbox, and contamination controls.

• 先读论文第 3.1–3.6 节：关键对象是 {F_opt,Q,T,C,O,A}，构造路径是 query/file synthesis -> GPT-4o-mini ReAct rollout -> executable-code gate -> query-file judge -> trajectory judge。
  • 严格区分规模单位：论文的 23.5K candidate、约 20K 个任务和约 15K 个文件，不等于固定版本的 21,168 条 JSON row 或 19,307 个 ZIP 文件；没有 manifest 对齐它们。
  • 把表 5 视为筛选 ablation，而不是 verifier 认证：GTA 从 50.00 升至 52.56，GAIA 从 13.33 升至 15.15，但没有报告 judge precision、recall、agreement 或独立正确性审计。
  • 对照阅读附录 A.1 与表 6：正文和表格给出矛盾的人类分数。声称可复现前，还要检查只面向图像的 verifier prompt 与仓库中失效的 final prompt path。
  • 复用阻断项包括 MIT 与 CC-BY-NC-4.0 数据集冲突、单独的 CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 模型标签、SA-1B/COCO 上游条款、HF schema 失败、缺少拒绝账本与 lineage，以及 privacy、sandbox 和 contamination 控制未披露。

value.html: An MM-Traj episode is represented in the paper as {F_opt, Q, T, C, O, A}: optional multimodal files, a query, stepwise thoughts, executable Python tool-call code, tool observations, and a final answer. The pinned HF JSON instead serializes a stable row ID, an image reference value, an answer string, and system/user/assistant conversations.

Human-brainstormed and double-checked seed queries are sampled as in-context examples; GPT-4o mini expands them using tool descriptions. The exact seed inventory, source membership, prompt inputs, and sampling seed used for the paper run are not released.

Python execution results and outputs from web search, image QA, file inspection, segmentation, localization, image generation or editing, face detection, and other allowed packages become ReAct observations.
Paper schema is {F_opt, Q, T, C, O, A}. Released answer values are strings, sometimes encoding Python-like dictionaries or lists rather than a normalized typed answer.
A zero-shot ReAct agent controlled by GPT-4o mini solves generated query-file tasks. Only trajectories whose code executes proceed to GPT-4o-mini query-file and trajectory judgments.

value.html: A Python-executing ReAct tool environment supports web search, image QA, file inspection, segmentation, object localization, image generation and editing, face detection, and a broad package allowlist. Inputs include images plus PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, CSV, audio, and other files.

A GPT-4o-mini query-file judge checks relevance, information sufficiency, and solvability with available tools. A GPT-4o-mini trajectory judge checks tool relevance, reasoning, consistency, arguments, observation-grounded synthesis, and final-answer relevance. There is no reported independent programmatic answer checker.
Query-file and trajectory judgments exist during construction, but their per-record responses, scores, confidence, and rejection reasons are not present in the public training payload.
No trained reward model or RL reward is reported. Executability and two affirmative GPT-4o-mini judgments are selection signals for SFT data.
Retention requires executable trajectory code and approval by both GPT-4o-mini judges. Execution establishes that code ran, not that the observation or final answer is semantically correct.

The paper reports filtering 23.5K candidates to about 20K retained records and evaluates a mixture of retained and filtered examples, but the release contains no rejected split, verifier outputs, rejection reasons, executable-status ledger, or accepted/rejected manifest.

Manual seed queries -> GPT-4o-mini query generation -> BGE image retrieval or GPT-4o-mini file generation -> GPT-4o-mini zero-shot ReAct rollout -> executable-code gate -> GPT-4o-mini query-file judgment -> GPT-4o-mini trajectory judgment -> conversation SFT export. Row-level source rights, generator/verifier decisions, and file mappings are incomplete.

At HF revision 360ab42fa086277c037bd4c1d3f8a0a61c96018e, mat_train.json has exactly 21,168 rows with unique IDs and the four fields id, image, answer, and conversations; data.zip has 19,307 regular files in 11 top-level directories. The HF viewer fails because the declared schema does not accommodate heterogeneous image values.

T3-Agent controllers are MiniCPM-V-8.5B and Qwen2-VL-7B. MM-Traj is mixed with Cauldron and open-LLaVA-NeXT; the vision encoder and compressor are frozen, with rank-64 LoRA on language-model q/k/v projections.
GPT-4o mini
GPT-4o mini generates queries and non-image file content/code and controls the zero-shot ReAct rollout; BGE retrieves images. The checked configuration names gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18.

Manually brainstormed, double-checked seed queries; tool descriptions; and a 93K image-caption pool from ChartQA, COCO, LLaVA, SAM, TextVQA, Web-Celebrity, Web-Landmark, and WikiArt, captioned with ShareGPT4V.

Seed demonstrations are randomly sampled and BGE retrieves top-similar images. Checked scripts use Python random sampling and temperature 1 but set no fixed seed; no paper-run prompt ledger, candidate order, retry ledger, or retrieval-index digest is released.

Paper funnel: 23.5K generated data points -> about 20K retained tasks with about 15K files. Pinned release: exactly 21,168 JSON rows and 19,307 regular ZIP files. No manifest reconciles these distinct units.

The paper says query-generation temperature is tuned but does not disclose it. Current generation and verifier scripts set temperature 1; an immutable binding between those scripts and the paper run is absent.
Executable rollout plus both GPT-4o-mini approvals. Per-row verifier responses, rejection causes, confidence, and a reproducible manifest are not released.

Keep trajectories whose code executes, then retain a record only when the query-file judge finds the files relevant, sufficient, and solvable and the trajectory judge approves the tool-use path and final answer.
No verifier is trained. GPT-4o mini is prompted for both judgment stages. Thirty programmers each rate 20 blindly mixed retained/filtered examples in a 600-sample human study.

Most paper trajectories have two to six steps, with some seven or eight. Maximum construction steps, token budget, timeouts, retries, and tool-cost budget are not disclosed. Fine-tuning context length is 10,240.

Five epochs; AdamW with cosine schedule; learning rate 1e-6; per-device batch size 2; context length 10,240; frozen vision encoder/compressor; and rank-64 LoRA on language-model q/k/v. Cross-entropy covers thought and code tokens across steps; final answer A is excluded from the loss.

The paper names ChartQA, COCO, LLaVA, SAM, TextVQA, Web-Celebrity, Web-Landmark, and WikiArt. The ZIP has 11 top-level directories, adding cocoqa, share_textvqa, and generated multimodal_file material. No per-source count and rights manifest explains this drift.

One JSON training payload is public. There is no train/validation/test, accepted/rejected, source, modality, difficulty, or benchmark-overlap manifest. The HF viewer is broken by heterogeneous image types.
No exact or semantic audit is reported against GTA, GAIA, Cauldron, open-LLaVA-NeXT, model pretraining, or the eight upstream image corpora.
unknown
The public payload is retained-data only. Filtered records used in the human study are not released with stable IDs, trajectories, verifier outputs, executable status, or rejection reasons.
